package report

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"example.com/ledger/account"
	"example.com/ledger/store"
)

func TestHiddenStatement(t *testing.T) {
	s := store.New()
	a := account.New("a1", "Ada", "EUR")
	a.Balance = 1250
	s.Put(a)
	b := account.New("b2", "Bo", "USD")
	b.Balance = -705
	b.Frozen = true
	s.Put(b)
	for id, want := range map[string]string{"a1": "Ada (a1): 12.50 EUR", "b2": "Bo (b2): -7.05 USD frozen"} {
		got, err := Statement(s, id)
		if err != nil || got != want {
			t.Fatalf("Statement(%s) = %q, %v, want %q", id, got, err, want)
		}
	}
	if _, err := Statement(s, "zz"); !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("missing id gave %v", err)
	}
}
